dependencyRoles.interpretation: The two package trees follow only dependencies, optionalDependencies and peerDependencies; devDependencies are never traversed. The CLI tree is broader than the Web Profile alone. Package inclusion is not file-level necessity or Android compatibility.

explicitProductionImageExclusions.frontendBuildInputs: Frontend source, Vite and the apps/web devDependencies build the static dist payload; they are not Node backend runtime package roots.

frontendStaticAssetAnalysis.analysisLimit: Index-local HTML references and complete built-output inventory; not a recursive JavaScript module graph or lazy client-plugin closure.
frontendStaticAssetAnalysis.scope: Built static frontend payload only; not the Node backend runtime image

bootstrap.moduleInterpretation: Resolution does not prove evaluation or necessity. The test helper injects a temporary runtime-roster observer; the capture metadata names the separate module-observer preload.

bounded.moduleInterpretation: Resolution does not prove evaluation or necessity. The test helper injects a temporary runtime-roster observer; the capture metadata names the separate module-observer preload.

limits: P3A-002 path rows are observations, not a required-file verdict; successful lookup/open does not prove content read or necessity.
P3A-001 module resolution does not prove evaluation or dependency necessity; capture metadata confirms a test-only runtime-roster observer was injected by the host helper.
The Web Profile bundle production tree follows manifest-declared production edges; the CLI launcher tree includes all CLI production dependencies and is broader than the Web Profile-specific closure.
The report does not infer that every observed path is required, nor does it resolve every dynamic import, client plugin batch, provider or runtime-generated file.
Static frontend analysis inventories built files and index.html references; it does not prove the dynamic browser plugin graph or end-to-end UI behavior.
Linux host evidence does not establish Android ARM64/Bionic compatibility, native dependency closure, Android startup, secure transport or Gate 4 acceptance.
